note: Exact materialized project and explicit agent buckets, including zero-valued unknown agents. Agent IDs are deduplicated and sorted. Basis is consistent across persisted projection reads only. Mutation replies do not return this basis; clients retain immediate effects using a local mutation epoch and refresh authoritative aggregates after acknowledgment, without arithmetic overlays.

basis_fencing.comparison: Opaque persisted store-incarnation/projection-generation basis. Compare equality only within the same store; foreign-store tokens are incomparable. Never parse, lexically order, increment, subtract or perform arithmetic on a basis.
basis_fencing.mutation_reply: No query basis is returned by mutation acknowledgment.

scenarios.name: late aggregate before acknowledgment
steps: Issue aggregate read at local mutation epoch N, capturing basis B.
Start user read/watch/assignment mutation; increment local epoch to N+1.
Old aggregate read arrives before acknowledgment.
Reject old aggregate installation because its captured local epoch N is obsolete.

scenarios.name: late aggregate after acknowledgment
steps: Issue aggregate read at epoch N.
Start user mutation; increment local epoch to N+1.
Mutation acknowledgment arrives without query basis.
Old aggregate arrives after acknowledgment; reject because epoch N is obsolete.
Issue fresh aggregate read after acknowledgment at epoch N+1.
Install fresh totals directly; no arithmetic overlay or double count.

scenarios.name: second mutation while refreshed read is pending
steps: After acknowledgment, issue fresh aggregate read at epoch N+1.
Another user mutation begins; increment epoch to N+2.
Read issued at N+1 arrives; reject despite being newer than the original read.
After second acknowledgment, refresh again and install authoritative totals directly.
